acceptance: safe_division defaults off; with it on, output matches the BenchBox helpers; semantic change (zero divisor returns NULL) is documented in the fork README.
Alias dedupe preserves the existing skip rules (SELECT *, ORDER/GROUP references) and handles nested selects, with tests.
Real-engine proof: Databricks TRY_DIVIDE and alias behavior run on local PySpark; BigQuery and Snowflake get AST tests and the missing real-engine evidence is recorded as a gap in the PR.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
description: Create the fork's sqlglot/benchbox/ package. Move the adapter-side AST rewrites: BigQuery SAFE_DIVIDE, Snowflake NULLIF divisor and Databricks TRY_DIVIDE behind one opt-in safe_division option (off by default); Databricks duplicate-output-alias suffixing; a function returning unqualified Table nodes (BigQuery dataset-state stays in the adapter); Databricks PRIMARY KEY NULLS FIRST/LAST removal as generator behavior.
